children: Australia's central bank may have to raise interest rates for a fourth time this year if inflation proves stronger than expected, a top official said on Tuesday.

Speaking at a property conference, Reserve Bank of Australia Assistant Governor Sarah Hunter also said the policy board was aiming to cool the economy through higher rates, but played down concerns about a possible recession.
